sentences.en: I'm really glad to have had such an enjoyable time.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴有这样的愉快时光。

sentences.en: He is talking, and his words sound sweet and enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 他在说话，他的言语听起来既甜蜜又令人愉悦。

sentences.en: They sabotaged my effort to make our class enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 他们破坏了我的努力，让我们的课堂不再那么有趣。
